import json,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from wire import v,envelope,stream,crypto,datagram,trace
from h import run
def T(events,**kw): return run({"traces":[trace(events,**kw)]})['traces'][0]
def P(r,w=''):
    print('---',w); print(json.dumps(r['packets'])); print(json.dumps(r['datagrams'])); print('closed',json.dumps(r['closed']))
K=[{'keys':['A']}]
# 1 long type unsupported
P(T(K+[datagram(bytes.fromhex('800000000101aa01bb000200'))]),'1 type 0x80')
# 2 version wrong
P(T(K+[datagram(bytes.fromhex('c00000000201aa01bb000200'))]),'2 version')
# 3 dcid len 21
P(T(K+[datagram(bytes.fromhex('c00000000115'+('aa'*21)+'01bb000200'))]),'3 dcid 21')
# 4 length < pn width
P(T(K+[datagram(bytes.fromhex('c30000000101aa01bb000000'))]),'4 length<pn')
# 5 length beyond
P(T(K+[datagram(bytes.fromhex('c00000000101aa01bb00ff00'))]),'5 length too big')
# 6 short fixed bit 0
P(T(K+[datagram(bytes.fromhex('00aa0001'))]),'6 fixed 0')
# 7 short reserved bits
P(T(K+[datagram(bytes.fromhex('58aa0001'))]),'7 reserved')
# 8 short truncated dcid
P(T(K+[datagram(bytes.fromhex('400001'))]),'8 truncated dcid')
# 9 good I then bad header in same datagram
w=envelope('I',0,b'\x01')+bytes.fromhex('80000000')
P(T([datagram(w,auth=[0,0])]),'9 good then bad')
# 10 auth beyond list
P(T(K+[datagram(envelope('A',0,b'\x01'))]),'10 no auth -> AUTH')
# 11 empty wire
P(T([datagram(b'')]),'11 empty')
# 12 token length varint overlong + token
head=bytes([0xc0])+b'\0\0\0\1'+bytes([1])+bytes.fromhex('aa')+bytes([1])+bytes.fromhex('bb')+v(0,8)+v(2,4)+bytes([0])+b'\x01'
P(T([datagram(head,auth=[0])]),'12 overlong header varints')
# 13 spin bit ignored
P(T(K+[datagram(bytes([0x40|0x20])+bytes.fromhex('aa')+bytes([0])+b'\x01',auth=[0])]),'13 spin')
PYEOF
